newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Crop fears keep Colombo rubber prices firm.
newsitem.headline: Crop fears keep Colombo rubber prices firm.

text.p: Rubber prices held firm at the Colombo auction on fears of a shortfall in the crop caused by drought, brokers and exporters said on Thursday.
"Buyers are worried that quantities are coming down," said a Forbes and Walker broker. "The weather is worsening."
Exporters said prices were likely to remain firm because of fears of poor production in the next two or three months.

Best latex one-x, the purest grade, sold for 75.35 rupees ($1.31) per kilo on Thursday compared to 75.40 on Tuesday when the auction was last held. Number one fetched 74.50 rupees per kg on both days while RSS 1 rose to 62.30 rupees from 62 rupees.
